capabilities: Extract text from PDFs, images and documents embedded in notes using OCR
Insert extracted text as an expandable callout below the embedded attachment
Run extraction on the active note, a folder, all notes, or a selection, with progress tracking and cancellation
Choose among OCR engines: Tesseract, Mistral OCR, OpenAI-compatible APIs, or a custom command
Expose a public API so other plugins can run the configured OCR engine
extras: Tesseract is free and fully local; Mistral OCR sends attachments to a third-party service. Custom commands are not supported on mobile (falls back to Tesseract). Extracted-text examples for each engine are hosted on Obsidian Publish, not in the README.
problem: Text inside embedded attachments like PDFs and images is invisible to Obsidian's search and other tools, because it is not stored as note text.

relations.evidence: Tesseract (the default option) is a popular open source OCR engine.
Mistral OCR is a powerful AI model for quickly extracting text from complex documents

summary: OCR plugin that extracts text from PDFs, images and documents embedded in notes and stores it below the attachment as a searchable callout.
